feeds.description: Yoga books for kids, yoga poses for kids, and yoga cards for kids to get them moving, learning, and having fun

feeds.title: Pretzel Kids Blog
feeds.description: Looking for the best kids yoga online course? Pretzel Kids yoga offers an affordable yoga teacher training course plus kids poses, classes and more. Want to learn how to teach kids yoga classes and run a childrens yoga business? Our kids yoga blog offers you free tips, tools and advice to start teaching kids yoga today!

feeds.title: Zenergy Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Important and relevant topics on the benefits of yoga for children and teens. Zenergy provides yoga programs for schools and conducts training courses on how to teach yoga to children. Zenergy Yoga is the premier provider of training on how to teach yoga to children and teens. Discover the privilege and opportunity of impacting the lives of children and teens through yoga.

feeds.title: Yo Re Mi News
feeds.description: What's happening  Your stories, our stories and stories from around the world! Bringing music and yoga classes to children throughout New York City.

feeds.title: Kidding Around Yoga Blog
feeds.description: A kids yoga blog, featuring asanas, Ayurveda, benefits of yoga, books, breathing, camp around yoga, craft, karma yoga, kay music, meditation, nutrition, philosophy, science of yoga, yoga activities, yoga at home, yoga marketing, and yoga stories. Kidding Around Yoga offers online & live kids yoga teacher training.

feeds.title: Young Yoga Masters
feeds.description: Focuses on kid's yoga activities, tools, and safety tips. Young Yoga Masters offers comprehensive Kids Yoga Teacher Training exceeding the Yoga Alliance industry standards.

feeds.title: Teaching Children Meditation Blog
feeds.description: The Teaching Children Meditation Blog offers child-centered mindfulness resources by sharing good practices, and ideas, and offers about teaching young people meditation. Read tips for stress-boosting and engaging in fun activities within the latest post. We are a worldwide program that empowers adults to teach children and teens meditation and mindfulness.

feeds.title: yogees-yoga-4-kids Blog
feeds.description: Expand your child's enrichment with yogees yoga 4 kids. Children will learn, develop self awareness, and have fun in a supportive nurturing Yoga environment.

feeds.title: Shining Kids Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Shining Kids Yoga was founded by local parent and yoga teacher, Andrea Creel, in 2014 as a way of bringing yoga, mindfulness, and relaxation to children through after-school yoga enrichment programs.

feeds.title: Yoga with Ms. Brandon Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about the life and experiences of a kids yoga teacher rebranding herself and finding new ways to teach yoga to children. Ms. Brandon shares her thoughts and insights learned from a long yoga journey that continues to evolve.

feeds.title: Yogi Squad Blog
feeds.description: Yogi Squad is on a mission to make yoga and mindfulness accessible to ALL CHILDREN. Our goal is to educate and equip all children with the tools to create their best life. No matter where we circle our mats, Yogi Squad is a safe community where kids and their yogis can join together to focus on self-awareness, mutual support, physical health, and resiliency.

feeds.title: Rainbow Yoga Training Blog
feeds.description: Rainbow Yoga is a fun and constantly evolving family mission. Rainbow was lovingly born in 2007, with the intention of giving people the tools to teach fun, engaging, and creative yoga classes for kids, teens, families, partners, and communities.

feeds.title: Mindful Child Aerial Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Tracy L. Daniel, the founder of Mindful Child Aerial Yoga and Wellness, has more than 20 years of experience as a psychologist and 5 years in special education administration. Dr. Tracy is a trained yoga professional, certified in Hatha, Kundalini, AntiGravity, and children's aerial yoga.

feeds.title: Peaceful Poses Kids Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Ann Fields, BFA, E-RYT-200, RCYT, is the founder of Peaceful Poses Kids Yoga. Ann specializes in teaching children yoga, mindfulness, meditation, pilates, ballet, and tapping (EFT). She teaches toddlers through teens, trauma-informed yoga, children with exceptional abilities, yoga for dancers, yoga for athletes, and adult pilates (mat and reformer) and yoga.

feeds.title: Children Inspired By Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Children Inspired by Yoga was created by interactive designer, yoga-teacher and entrepreneur Sam Petter. Whilst on maternity leave Sam dreamt of a class for her baby son where the fun and magic of childhood were ignited whilst learning new skills for life and remaining true to her ethical principals

feeds.title: Flow and Grow Kids Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Free yoga resources & tools, teaching ideas, interviews with important kids wellness entrepreneurs, insights, information on child development, and more!

feeds.title: Zensational Kids
feeds.description: We believe that every child has unlimited potential, no matter what circumstances have crossed their path or diagnosis they have been given. We help educational communities unlock that potential through the implementation of evidence-based yoga and mindfulness practices that build social and emotional learning, coping skills and self-regulation strategies.

feeds.title: Global Family Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Real life stories of Yoga with children and other related topics. Our yoga instructor certification program, yoga teacher training, and e-courses help you learn how to teach yoga to kids, toddlers, and families.. Mira is happy to talk Yoga with all who share her passion.

feeds.title: YoPlay Yoga for Kids Blog
feeds.description: YoPlay Yoga For Kids incorporates playful yoga poses, breathing exercises and relaxation techniques helping children learn to stretch and strengthen their bodies, be mindful, release stress, feel better about themselves and calm their emotions - all of which makes them healthier and happier

feeds.title: Glow Yoga Kids
feeds.description: Glow Yoga has been providing mobile yoga enrichment programs to Edmonton & area schools and groups since 2011. Our main goal is to uplift and empower children to feel happy, healthy and connected.

feeds.title: Appleseed Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Appleseed Yoga's (AY) blog is a space for the exploration of ideas and thoughts relating to kid's yoga, mindfulness, and parenting. Often it is reflective of the personal journey of AY's Founder, Megan Snider. We specialize in yoga for kids and families and are based in Riverside, a neighbourhood in Toronto's downtown eastside.

feeds.title: The ABCs of Yoga for Kids Blog
feeds.description: Learn about yoga poses, asanas for kids on Yoga for Kids

feeds.title: Mini Me Yoga News
feeds.description: With an amazing team of experts from various backgrounds based around working with children, we are dedicated to sharing mental health & well-being programs/techniques with educators/parents via fun workshops.

feeds.title: Breathe & Flow Yoga Blog
feeds.description: We bring our passion and expertise in Kid's Yoga to Early Childhood Centres all across Australia. Our kid's yoga programs are linked with the Early Learning Years Framework. Our Kid's Yoga sessions help children to develop coordination, self-control, discipline, and resilience.

feeds.title: Butterfly Kids Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to Butterfly Kids Yoga! My name is Ali and I started Butterfly Kids Yoga in 2016. Since our very first class, my goal has been to offer kids and families a healthy, mindful way to enjoy movement, mindfulness, fun, creativity, exercise, and calm -- all in one. Read about upcoming events, Butterfly Kids Yoga news, and helpful yoga tips.

feeds.title: Soul Mates Kids Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Soul Mates is a fun and playful adaption of yoga and mindfulness for kids aimed at activating the body and calming the mind. Amy Holden, psychologist, and certified mindfulness instructor have developed the Soul Mates characters which each embody key mindfulness concepts adapted to be accessible to young children. At Soul Mates we think of these concepts as superpowers.

feeds.title: Yogamazia Blog
feeds.description: Yogamazia is a studio 'Empowering kids to learn and love yoga' in order to strengthen their body, mind, and spirit starting from the womb. Help your child find their sanctuary to cultivate inner peace with us.
